role: special interest community group supporting rapid transit
stance_basis: ACT joined Joint Executive Committee formed to unite groups in demonstrating community support for rapid transit
summary: The Area Committee for Transit (ACT) is described as a special interest community group whose chairman participated in the Joint Executive Committee for Rapid Transit, formed in May 1975 at the request of the Erie County Executive and the Mayor of Buffalo. The Joint Committee was explicitly designed to unite these groups in a demonstration of community support for rapid transit, indicating ACT's supportive stance toward the project.
complaint_summary: ACT's chairman was included in the Joint Executive Committee for Rapid Transit, formed to unite community groups in demonstrating support for rapid transit in the Buffalo-Amherst Corridor.
summary_quote: It was composed of the chairmen of the Mass Transit Advisory Committee, the Area Committee for Transit (ACT), and the No Overhead Transit (NOT) organization (the latter two being special interest community groups).
